title: Stalker
creator: Andrei Tarkovsky
place: Kultuurikatel, the old city power station
description: Tarkovsky’s slow, haunting film about a guide who leads two men into the Zone, a forbidden area where wishes may come true. Much of it was shot in and around Tallinn, in abandoned power stations and industrial areas.

title: The Singing Revolution
creator: James Tusty and Maureen Castle Tusty
description: An American documentary on how Estonians used their song festivals to resist Soviet rule, from the deportations of the 1940s to the mass singing of 1988 and independence in 1991.

title: Tenet
creator: Christopher Nolan
description: Nolan’s time-bending thriller filmed a long sequence in Tallinn, including a car chase on the Laagna Road highway, which was closed for weeks, and scenes in the abandoned Linnahall.
